Messages.Author: Marko Saari
Messages.Body:
Can the controller of vampire that is targeted by HT bid more than he has
pool?
For example player A`s Bianca is targeted by HT and player have 6 pool. Can
he bid 7 (or more) pool, because if he wins he should only pay half of it (4
pool)?

Thanks

Marko

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. Each Methuselah can bid up to what she can fund. For the controller,
that means she can bid up to twice her current pool amount.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <7pdmas$dmh$1...@tron.sci.fi>, Marko Saari <gu...@sci.fi>
writes

>For example player A`s Bianca is targeted by HT and player have 6 pool. Can
>he bid 7 (or more) pool, because if he wins he should only pay half of it (4
>pool)?

On an entirely different track entirely...

At any point during the bidding war, the controlling player should
always be bidding even numbers. At, say, five pool, he pays 3 at the
end of it. At six pool, he still pays three. However, six pool is that
little bit more expensive for other people than five pool.
